facts.value: The application is submitted online through the central online portal for master's programs of Goethe University in cooperation with uni-assist e.V.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: Applicants must upload all required documents, such as a CV and certificates, using the upload function in the Uni-Assist portal and associate them with their application.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: Further information about the online application process can be found here.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: There are no application fees for master's programs at Goethe University. No processing fee needs to be paid to uni-assist.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: For technical questions, please contact uni-assist directly.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: For content-related questions about the application, please contact the academic advising.
